name: git-worktrees
description: Git worktree support for ZCode: create, list, inspect, remove, and clean up isolated worktrees with carry-over of ignored files (.worktreeinclude), snapshots before deletion, retention sweeps, PR checkouts, and background agent tasks.

worktree_root.title: Worktree root
worktree_root.description: Directory where worktrees are stored, one subdirectory per project. Shorthand ~ is allowed.

default_base.title: Default base
default_base.description: Base for new worktrees: "fresh" (origin/HEAD, fetched if stale, falls back to local HEAD when offline), "head" (current local HEAD), or any explicit branch, tag, or commit.

max_age_days.title: Max age (days)
max_age_days.description: Managed worktrees with no activity for longer than this are removed by worktrees_cleanup (dirty or locked ones are always skipped).

max_count.title: Max worktrees per project
max_count.description: worktrees_cleanup keeps at most this many managed worktrees per project, removing the least recently active ones first.

auto_session.title: Auto session worktrees
auto_session.description: Give every new session in a repository's main checkout its own isolated worktree (resumes return to it; main-checkout edits are redirected). Applies from the next session. The /worktree:auto command also toggles it (most recent change wins), and a repo can opt out via .zcode/worktree.json {"autoSession": false}.
